## Figma Design (Dark Mode): Roadmap

**Figma frame:** _Roadmap_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design

> **Design-only issue** — work in Figma, not in code.
> **Depends on:** UI-17 (tokens and theme), UI-19 (cards, badges, and tags), UI-20 (responsive layout grid).

### Context

Timeline/roadmap section showing planned milestones and what’s shipping next.

### What to design (in Figma)

- Roadmap heading, introduction, and timeline or milestone layout.
- Milestone card treatment with planned and next-up status information.
- A mobile layout that preserves chronology and status clarity.

### Deliverables

- Desktop and mobile roadmap frames with representative milestone states.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Planned milestones and what is shipping next are easy to distinguish
- [ ] Timeline or roadmap structure remains understandable at all breakpoints
- [ ] Status treatments do not rely on color alone
- [ ] Uses UI-17 tokens, UI-19 components, and UI-20 grid rules
- [ ] Figma frame link is shared for review

### Important rules

- Get assigned before beginning work.
- Work only in the assigned Figma frame.
- Use the shared design system and reusable components; do not use loose styles.
- Dark mode only.
